text:
alyssa: Heads-up — trying to reconcile the new status lexicon with existing fallback rules. Need a short decision today so console rollout doesn't stall.

mike: quick q: do we treat 'degraded' as 429 or 503?

jia: my vote: degraded -> 200 with header x-rw-status: degraded; 429 reserved for quota/shaping

sloane: +1 to non-error 200 for soft degradations, avoids client-side breakage. But console badge needs clear tooltip.

alyssa: if we go 200+header, SDKs need a stable enum. propose header `x-rw-status: degraded|fallback|ok|throttle`

mike: can we add `x-rw-retry-after-ms` for client hints? helps backoff without forcing 429 semantics

jia: ok, but telemetry needs signal parity with 429 so we can alert on user impact. Suggest emit metric `client_visible.status=degraded` alongside normal http status

sloane: console: show yellow badge "Degraded — partial model fallback" with link to route details. UX: show last 1hr affected % and top tenants.

alyssa: rollout plan: v1 header + telemetry + console badge behind feature flag. If flag=off, behavior remains 429/503. owners: @jia telemetry, @mike SDK, @sloane console

mike: SDK PR stub in https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/234 — adds enum and helper `isDegraded(resp)`

deploy-bot: deploy queued: canary to 10% hosts at 16:40 UTC

jia: small config suggestion: add `rw.status_category` to trace spans so sampling can pick these up, e.g., `rw.status_category=degraded`

sloane: UX question: do we show "Quota" vs "Degraded" to end users differently? proposal: quota->red(explain link), degraded->yellow(with auto-retry note)

alyssa: decision checkpoint — we adopt header `x-rw-status`, add `x-rw-retry-after-ms`, emit telemetry event 'client_visible.status', add trace tag, console badge yellow for degraded. Follow-up: define exact text for console tooltip (assign to @sloane). Any objections?

mike: none from me.

jia: lgtm.

sloane: ack, will draft tooltip copy and put in drive.

alyssa: thanks — adding to RFC doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-example-status-lexicon-rfc
